meaning: From Chlamydoselachus: Greek chlamýs “cloak” + sélachos “cartilaginous fish”, for the first pair of gill slits that fit like a cloak or frill around the throat; -idae “family of”
description: Eel-shaped sharks with six pairs of frilly gill slits, a wide mouth full of three-pointed teeth and a long tail. The family has a single genus, Chlamydoselachus.
